subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `gen-index`, docgate shall emit the tech-design index (`index.md` + `index.json`) deterministically with liveness computed from `Supersedes` edges, lineage, `Serves` inverse map, and staleness flags; `verify-index` shall byte-reject any committed index differing from the recomputed one.
rationale: the class's projection; liveness computed, never written
fit_criterion: hand-edited index red; regenerated green; fixture graph incl. a supersession chain yields expected liveness and flags
